scenario.topic: Choose a board game to buy for the common room
scenario.opening_question: What kind of board game vibe should we go for that fits our group and space?

options.name: Ticket to Ride Europe
options.upside: Easy to learn with strategic depth and good replayability
options.tradeoff: Can be slow-paced and less engaging for highly competitive players
options.concern: Some players might find the luck element frustrating
options.best_for: casual groups wanting a balanced strategy game

options.name: Splendor Card Game
options.upside: Quick setup and fast rounds with elegant resource management
options.tradeoff: Limited player interaction may feel less social
options.concern: May become repetitive after many plays
options.best_for: groups wanting a light, quick, and competitive game

options.name: Pandemic Cooperative Board Game
options.upside: Encourages teamwork and problem solving with a strong theme
options.tradeoff: Can be stressful and challenging, possibly frustrating for casual players
options.concern: Some may prefer competitive games over cooperative ones
options.best_for: groups that enjoy cooperative play and strategic planning

options.name: Kingdomino Tile-Laying Game
options.upside: Simple rules with quick, engaging gameplay and easy setup
options.tradeoff: Less depth for players seeking complex strategy
options.concern: Might feel too light or simplistic for experienced gamers
options.best_for: groups prioritizing fast, casual, and family-friendly games

shared_context: Game should be playable in about 30-60 minutes
